cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — standing with one foot up on a step; her private orbital sleeper-train cabin — the train briefly enters zero gravity during her quiet wake-up; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; an empty orbital recreation dome with a shallow indoor putting green and a star-filled panoramic window — she watches a small white practice ball complete a very slow curve toward the hole and leans forward in amused suspense; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — carries a paper shopping bag at her side; the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — turns a page of a book lying open on the table; a walled garden with a lotus pond — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — standing with one foot up on a step; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — carries a small storage box against her waist; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing
